title: Alice
tagline: Alice is a web3 2D game where players guide a girl through societal pressures and inner conflicts. They collect coins for acceptance and mint ALC tokens using a voucher system
description:
Alice is a web3 2D game that follows the journey of a young girl as she navigates the relentless pressure to conform to society's standards. As players guide Alice through her struggles, they will witness her battling against societal expectations and her own inner conflicts.

Throughout the game, players will encounter a mysterious girl who speaks in random phrases generated by AI. As Alice collects coins to gain social acceptance, she must also dodge road bombs that will cause her to lose all of her progress.

At the end of the game, players can mint the ERC20 ALC tokens they have earned through a voucher system that is cryptographically signed. Through this journey, players will come to understand that Alice's greatest obstacle was herself.
how_its_made:
The project in question is a game that was developed using Unity, a game engine that enabled the creation of engaging and interactive gameplay experiences. In addition, the images used in the game were generated using the cutting-edge technology of Midjournew Bot, which allowed for the creation of stunning and immersive visual assets.

To enhance the game's narrative and immersion, NPC dialogue was generated using Chat GPT, which utilized a JSON file that can be easily updated to incorporate new dialogue options. This feature added an extra layer of complexity and depth to the game's storytelling elements.

To ensure the security and reliability of the game's functionality, a smart contract was implemented using Solidity, a programming language designed for creating decentralized applications. The smart contract was integrated with Chain Safe and API, which helped to ensure that the game's blockchain interactions were both seamless and secure.

To facilitate the creation of in-game vouchers, a custom Java script was developed, which allowed for the easy creation and management of virtual coupons.

The game was deployed on the Chiado Testnet (Gnosis) blockchain, which provided a secure and reliable platform for players to interact with the game's mechanics. Overall, the use of these cutting-edge technologies helped to create an immersive and engaging gameplay experience that was both secure and user-friendly.
